name: Rover (Spectro)

tierList.prydwen: Support: T1.5 Tower of Adversity, T2 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: Free 5-star Spectro Sword jack-of-all-trades (healing, CC, debuff, Sub-DPS) whose only real meta niche is applying Spectro Frazzle for Phoebe (currently mandatory pairing). All Sequence Nodes unlocked for free, including a Spectro RES Shred at S6.

skills.normalAttack: Basic Attack - Vibration Manifestation (4 hits) / Heavy Attack -> Resonance -> Aftertune chain.
skills.forte: World in a Grain of Sand - governs Diminutive Sound (max 100) -> enhanced Skill (Resonating Spin, 2 Frazzle stacks + Shimmer) -> Resonating Echoes.
skills.liberation: Echoing Orchestra - Spectro AoE hit, applies 6 Spectro Frazzle stacks.
skills.intro: Waveshock - Spectro strike, builds Diminutive Sound.
skills.outro: Instant - stasis field around next character for 3s.

bestWeapons: Lunar Cutter (86.05%, best short field time)

teams.name: Best Team
teams.notes: Currently mandatory together - Phoebe's Absolution mode needs a Spectro Frazzle applier and Rover is one of only two in the game.

rotation: Heavy Atk -> Resonance -> Aftertune -> Forte: Resonating Spin -> Whirl -> (swap while Skill on CD) -> Intro -> Ultimate -> Basic P1,2 -> Forte: Resonating Spin -> Whirl -> Resonating Echoes P1,2 -> Outro.
communityNotes: Prydwen: a true jack-of-all-trades (healing, damage, CC, debuff) but master of none, whose sole current meta relevance is as Phoebe's Spectro Frazzle applier - outside that pairing they have no strong niche and could be outclassed the moment another Frazzle applier releases.
